infernal_native_link_review.initial_material_copy_stopped_before_wri: Do not assume HeroPower API has childIds. Complete Jaraxxus primary responses explicitly list token1143 and power1178 separately; exact fixed6/6 native text connects them, no prefix or same-name inference.

source_verification_scope: Common prepare strictly verifies all eleven child faces and all21 full raw rows. Full primary parent bodies and exact child links are independently retained; parent dynamic/proxy display mismatches are evidence only, not normalized or claimed implemented.

local_policies.health_reward: A positive actual DAMAGE result on this original Plume residence accepts one Fire-spell reward even if lethal. Original target ID/controller/face epoch/order are checked; no living-source predicate. Native trigger acceptance/lifecycle and ordinary generation rollback apply.
local_policies.random_healing: Owner-end trigger samples only currently wounded active friendly hero/minions. Capture the selected original minion residence or hero allocation; if it departs before healing, skip without resampling. Ordinary EFFECT healing3 and overheal rules apply.
local_policies.death_buff: The real deathrattle controller samples an active living friendly minion once; apply +2 Attack to its original MinionReference through the shared stat executor.
local_policies.battlecries: Gold deals4 to one ordinary available character target. Storm deals2 simultaneously to active enemy minions. Both are MINION_ABILITY; native Lifesteal and original health outcomes own healing, not Spell Damage.
local_policies.power: INFERNO! is the noncollectible native Warlock HERO_POWER with ordinary two-mana account, board-space requirement and normal per-turn use cap. One attributed SummonByCard creates the named fresh6/6 Infernal. No Jaraxxus parent definition or parent battlecry is added.
local_policies.vanilla: Exact printed bodies and only explicit native Reborn/Taunt; empty Juvenile, Nether Imp and Infernal have no parent-provided on-summon health theft or extra granted effects.
local_policies.cn_status: Timing/selection/source policies are internal public-contract applications and await M6; child source/parent reachability evidence does not prove parent implementations or formal pools.
